biggest_catch: The friend must complete 10 debit card transactions AND a $250+ direct deposit within 60 days of account opening - a simple join pays nothing.
catches: Referrer must register for the program and share the offer with friends, family, or coworkers.
Referrer earns a $50 reward bonus per referred individual who registers, opens a new Heritage High-Yield, Loyalty Rewards, or Traditional checking account, and completes the requirements.
Cap: $500 in reward bonuses per calendar year; only one referrer per referred person.

Friend must: register via the referral email/social link; open a qualifying checking account; within 60 days complete 10+ debit card transactions (excluding ATMs), 1+ direct deposits totaling $250+, and keep the account in good standing.
Bonus appears in the Membership Share account up to 60 days after all requirements are met.
Bonuses are considered interest and reported on IRS Form 1099-MISC.
Offer can be changed at any time without notice.
